title: Higher-dimensional singularities of rational inner functions
summary: We study singularities of rational inner functions (RIFs) $φ$ in three and more variables. We focus on curve and higher-dimensional singularities of $φ$ in $\mathbb{T}^n$ and we show that, under certain conditions, derivative integrability conditions of partial derivatives of $φ=\frac{q}{p}$ stay constant along irreducible components of the zero set of $p$, and that the presence of vertical line singularities does not affect global integrability. This answers Question 2 in arXiv:1906.10913. Those results are then generalized to $n$ variables. Finally, we consider slice matrices, which we use…
